scope_note: Selected mandatory label declarations for pre-packaged food offered for retail sale in India, drawn from the Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020. This pack is a bounded MVP subset and is not a complete statement of Indian food labelling law. Category-specific standards, Legal Metrology declarations beyond net quantity, and product-specific schedules are largely out of scope.

sources.name: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 (compendium, Version-I dated 23.09.2021)
sources.publisher: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India

rules.requirement: The label must carry the name of the food on the front of pack, indicating the true nature of the food.
rules.source_excerpt: Every package of food shall carry name of the food which indicate the true nature of the food contained in the package, on the Front of Pack
rules.evidence_hint: Product name text on the front panel. A brand name alone does not satisfy this if it does not describe the food.
rules.suggested_fix: Print a descriptive name of the food on the front of pack in addition to any brand or coined name.

rules.requirement: A titled list of ingredients must be declared in descending order of composition by weight or volume, except for single ingredient foods.
rules.source_excerpt: Except for single ingredient foods, a list of ingredients shall be declared on the label ... The list of ingredients shall contain an appropriate title, such as the term "Ingredients/List of Ingredients" ... listed in descending order of their composition by weight or volume

applicability.summary: All pre-packaged food other than single ingredient foods.

rules.evidence_hint: Look for a heading such as Ingredients followed by a comma separated list.
rules.suggested_fix: Add a titled ingredients list ordered by descending weight at the time of manufacture.

rules.requirement: Nutritional information must be declared on the label.
rules.source_excerpt: Nutritional information.- ... shall be given on the label

applicability.summary: All pre-packaged food, subject to the exemptions in regulation 8.

rules.evidence_hint: A nutrition table listing energy and macronutrients per 100 g or 100 ml or per serving.
rules.suggested_fix: Add a nutrition information panel with energy and the nutrients required by regulation 5(3).
rules.notes: The MVP only checks presence of a nutrition panel. It does not validate nutrient rows, units, per serve declarations or rounding.

rules.requirement: The label must carry the vegetarian or non-vegetarian symbol and colour code appropriate to the product.
rules.source_excerpt: Every package of Vegetarian Food containing ingredients including food additives, processing aids of plant origin shall bear a declaration to this effect by a symbol and colour code ... The symbol shall consist of a green colour filled circle inside a square with green outline

applicability.summary: All pre-packaged food intended for human consumption.

rules.evidence_hint: Green filled circle in a green square for vegetarian, brown triangle in a brown square for non-vegetarian.
rules.suggested_fix: Print the correct veg or non-veg symbol at the size required by regulation 5(4)(c).

rules.requirement: The name and complete address of the brand owner must be declared, preceded by a qualifying phrase such as Manufactured by, Marketed by or Packed and Marketed by.
rules.source_excerpt: The name and complete address of the brand owner ... shall be declared on the label. Such name and address shall be preceded by the qualifying words "Manufactured by (Mfg by, Mfd by)" or "Marketed by (Mkt by)" or "Manufactured & Marketed by" or "Packed & Marketed by"
rules.evidence_hint: Address block on the back or side panel with a qualifying phrase.
rules.suggested_fix: Add the full brand owner name and address with the correct qualifying phrase.

rules.requirement: The FSSAI logo and licence number must be displayed on the label in a colour contrasting with the background.
rules.source_excerpt: The FSSAI logo and license number under the Act shall be displayed on the label of the food package in contrast color to the background

applicability.summary: All pre-packaged food sold in India.

rules.evidence_hint: FSSAI logo with a 14 digit licence number printed near it.
rules.suggested_fix: Print the FSSAI logo together with the 14 digit licence number in a contrasting colour.

rules.requirement: Net quantity, retail sale price and consumer care details must be declared in the manner provided by the Legal Metrology Act, 2009 and rules made under it.
rules.source_excerpt: Declaration and manner of declaration of Net quantity, Retail Sale Price and Consumer Care details shall be as provided in Legal Metrology Act, 2009 (1 of 2010) and the Rules made there under.

applicability.summary: All pre-packaged food sold at retail.

rules.evidence_hint: Net quantity such as Net Wt. 200 g or Net Vol. 500 ml, usually on the front panel.
rules.suggested_fix: Declare net quantity with an approved unit, plus retail sale price and consumer care contact details.
rules.notes: The MVP checks net quantity presence and unit plausibility only. Retail sale price and consumer care details are checked as presence, and Legal Metrology placement and font rules are out of scope.

rules.requirement: A batch number, code number or lot number must be declared on the label.
rules.source_excerpt: A batch number or code number or lot number shall be declared on the label.
rules.evidence_hint: Text such as Batch No., Lot No. or Code No. followed by an identifier.
rules.suggested_fix: Print a batch, lot or code identifier on the pack.

rules.requirement: Date of manufacture or packaging and expiry or use by date must both be declared and grouped together at one place.
rules.source_excerpt: "Date of manufacture or packaging" and "Expiry/Use by" shall be declared on the label. However, expression "Best before" may also be used as optional or additional information ... shall be grouped together and given at one place.

applicability.summary: All pre-packaged food except the categories listed in regulation 5(10)(d), such as wine, alcoholic beverages of 10 percent ABV or more, vinegar, solid sugars and chewing gum.

rules.evidence_hint: Date block showing manufacturing or packing date and an expiry or use by date.
rules.suggested_fix: Print both the date of manufacture or packaging and the expiry or use by date together in one place.

rules.requirement: The country of origin must be declared on the label of food imported into India.
rules.source_excerpt: The country of origin of the food shall be declared on the label of food imported into India.
rules.evidence_hint: Statement such as Country of Origin: ... together with importer details.
rules.suggested_fix: Declare the country of origin and the name and complete address of the importer in India.

rules.requirement: Allergen causing ingredients must be declared separately as a Contains statement naming the allergens.
rules.source_excerpt: The following foods and ingredients which are known to cause allergy shall be declared separately as Contains............ (Name of allergy causing ingredients)

applicability.summary: Where the product contains one of the listed allergens. Raw agricultural commodities are exempt, and the declaration is not required where the product itself is a food allergen.

rules.evidence_hint: A separate Contains statement, distinct from the ingredients list. May Contains is used for cross contamination.
rules.suggested_fix: Add a separate Contains statement naming each allergen present, in addition to the ingredients list.
rules.notes: Listed allergens under 5(14) include cereals containing gluten, crustacea, milk, eggs, fish, peanuts, tree nuts, soybeans and sulphite at 10 mg/kg or more.

rules.requirement: Numerals and letters required by the regulations on the principal display panel must meet the minimum height for the panel area, and label contents must be legible.
rules.source_excerpt: The height of any numeral and letter required under these regulations, on the principal display panel shall be as shown in table below ... Upto 100 cm2: 1 mm; Above 100 cm2 upto 500 cm2: 2 mm; Above 500 cm2 upto 2500 cm2: 4 mm; Above 2500 cm2: 6 mm
rules.evidence_hint: Smallest mandatory text on the principal display panel, compared against the panel area band.
rules.suggested_fix: Increase the size of mandatory declarations to meet the minimum height for the principal display panel area.
rules.notes: Physical millimetre height cannot be measured from an image without a known pack dimension. The MVP evaluates this only when panel dimensions are supplied with the case, otherwise the finding is reported as uncertain.

rules.requirement: Products containing ingredients or additives listed in Schedule II must carry the prescribed warning statement, for example CONTAINS CAFFEINE for added caffeine and a laxative effect warning for 10 percent or more polyols.
rules.source_reference: Schedule II, paragraph 1 (Mandatory Declarations), read with regulation 7
rules.source_excerpt: Wherever, packaged food contains ingredients and/or additives as stated in schedule-II of these regulations, the same shall be prominently displayed on the label ... 10% or more polyols: Polyols may have laxative effect; Added caffeine: CONTAINS CAFFEINE

applicability.summary: Only where the product contains a Schedule II trigger ingredient or additive.

rules.evidence_hint: Prescribed warning text printed on the pack, matched to the trigger ingredient.
rules.suggested_fix: Add the exact Schedule II warning statement required for the trigger ingredient.
rules.notes: The MVP implements a small subset of Schedule II triggers: added caffeine, polyols at 10 percent or more, polydextrose at 10 percent or more, and aspartame.
